system_description.narrative_title: Global central-bank tightening and rising bond yields
system_description.narrative_summary: Major central banks are synchronously tightening policy to combat persistent inflation, pushing government bond yields to multi-decade highs and forcing a broad market re-pricing. As an open system, policy decisions, inflation data, and central-bank communication transmit through yields, currency moves and capital flows into equity valuations, housing finance, corporate and private credit, and investor behaviour, with feedbacks from market volatility and political pressures back into policy. The dominant dynamics are interest-rate setting, inflation expectations, risk premia, and cross-border capital allocation.
system_description.scope: Central-bank policy decisions and forward guidance; sovereign bond markets and yield curves; investor flows between bonds, equities and cash; currency moves; equity market breadth and options activity; mortgage and housing finance conditions; corporate and private credit pricing and risk; market sentiment and media/communication signals.
system_description.super_system: Global macro-financial-economic system (inflation, growth, fiscal policy, geopolitics)
adjacent_subsystems: Corporate credit and private credit / pensions
Equity markets (tech/AI and broad market breadth)

variables.name: Policy interest rate
variables.description: The short-term nominal interest rate set as the operative target of monetary policy that anchors short-term funding rates.

variables.name: Monetary-policy communication tone
variables.description: The hawkishness or dovishness and clarity of forward guidance and public commentary from monetary authorities as perceived by markets.

variables.name: Inflation expectations
variables.description: Market and household expectations of future inflation over short and medium horizons.

variables.name: Nominal yield curve level
variables.description: The pattern of observed nominal interest rates across maturities for sovereign debt, summarising term structure pricing.

variables.name: Real yield level
variables.description: Inflation-adjusted yields across key maturities that capture the real return available to investors.

variables.name: Term premium level
variables.description: The additional yield investors demand for holding longer-duration debt beyond expected short rates.

variables.name: Credit spread level
variables.description: The average premium required for non-sovereign credit over comparable sovereign yields, reflecting default and liquidity risk.

variables.name: Mortgage borrowing costs
variables.description: The effective interest rates and lending conditions faced by home borrowers for typical mortgage products.

variables.name: Housing market demand
variables.description: Aggregate demand for housing transactions and purchases, including buyer activity and willingness to pay.

variables.name: Equity risk premium
variables.description: The excess return investors require to hold equities over risk-free assets, reflecting valuation and expected returns.

variables.name: Asset allocation tilt
variables.description: The distribution of investor portfolios across major asset classes (bonds, equities, cash) and shifts in that allocation.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flow rate
variables.description: The net rate of financial capital moving between jurisdictions, including portfolio, bank and direct flows.

variables.name: Exchange rate level
variables.description: The relative price of a currency against relevant peers, capturing appreciation or depreciation pressure.

variables.name: Market liquidity
variables.description: The ease, depth and cost of executing large transactions across financial markets without large price impact.

variables.name: Market volatility level
variables.description: The magnitude of short- to medium-term price fluctuations and implied volatility across asset classes.

variables.name: Systemic leverage
variables.description: Aggregate leverage in the financial system including borrowing by intermediaries and leveraged investors.

catalysts.title: Fed continues hawkish tightening
catalysts.description: Ongoing Fed rate-hike cycle and follow-up policy moves as markets price further increases after the recent unanimous hike and Warsh's hawkish signals.
catalysts.rationale: Fed delivers first rate hike since 2023; Warsh signals seriousness and markets expect more (2026-09-18, 2026-09-19).

catalysts.title: 10‑year Treasury stays elevated (>~5%)
catalysts.description: Sustained high long‑term US yields as markets reprice inflation, policy and real yields after recent spikes above multi‑year levels.
catalysts.rationale: Ten-year hit highest since 2007; headlines expect 10‑year to get above and stay above 5% (2026-09-18).

catalysts.title: Bank of Japan tightening follow‑through
catalysts.description: BOJ continues adjusting policy after raising rates to 31‑year highs, driving cross‑market reallocation and yen volatility.
catalysts.rationale: BOJ raised rates to 31‑year high; markets flipped script and yen slumped after move (2026-09-18, 2026-09-19).

catalysts.title: BoE shifts toward hikes / possible rate rises
catalysts.description: BoE's tone turning hawkish and inflation set to top 4% raises prospect of tightening, affecting gilts and UK borrowing costs.
catalysts.rationale: BoE shifts tone toward rate hikes as inflation set to top 4% (2026-09-18 headlines).

catalysts.title: BoE halts long‑dated gilt sales / QE unwind rewrite
catalysts.description: BoE stops long‑dated gilt sales and revises QE unwind plans, directly affecting term premia and long‑end liquidity.
catalysts.rationale: BoE halts long‑dated gilt sales and rewrites plan to unwind QE (2026-09-18).

catalysts.title: Continued decline in China's US‑Treasury holdings
catalysts.description: Ongoing reduction in Chinese holdings of US Treasuries lowers foreign demand and pressures yields and cross‑border flows.
catalysts.rationale: China's US Treasury holdings fall to lowest level since 2008, implying continued withdrawal (2026-09-18).

catalysts.title: Mortgage rates approach ~7%
catalysts.description: Consumer mortgage costs climb toward seven percent as long‑term and real yields rise, squeezing housing demand and builders.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines warn of a 7% mortgage and homebuilders are under pressure from rising rates (2026-09-18, 2026-09-19).

catalysts.title: Private‑credit spillover into pensions/annuities
catalysts.description: Growing private‑credit exposure to annuities and pensions raises systemic credit‑risk and potential market stress if defaults or mark‑downs occur.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines flag risks from private credit's involvement in annuities and pensions and a new credit debacle (2026-09-18, 2026-09-19).

catalysts.title: Sustained hawkish central‑bank communication
catalysts.description: Consistently terse, hawkish central‑bank messaging (e.g., short Fed statements, Warsh comments) shifts market expectations and volatility.
catalysts.rationale: Fed terse 130‑word statement and Warsh comments; markets read hawkish signals (2026-09-18, 2026-09-19).
